sources.content: The stonrick-backup image runs Stonrick, a tool that backs up mounted volumes to object storage on a schedule. It is built on alpine:3.19 and runs as user ID 1000 by default; run it as root only when the source files need it. Mount the data to back up read only at /source. Stonrick keeps a local index at /var/lib/stonrick, which should be a volume. The entrypoint is /usr/local/bin/stonrick daemon. The image exposes no ports.

Settings. STONRICK_SCHEDULE takes a cron expression and defaults to 0 2 * * *, a run at 02:00 each day. STONRICK_BUCKET names the target bucket and is required. STONRICK_KEEP_DAILY defaults to 7 and STONRICK_KEEP_WEEKLY defaults to 4. Backups are encrypted with the key in STONRICK_PASSPHRASE; if it is unset, the container refuses to start. Health is checked by stonrick status every 5 minutes. STONRICK_ENDPOINT sets the object storage URL for services other than AWS S3.

claims.text: Stonrick expects the data to back up at /source.
The stonrick-backup container refuses to start when STONRICK_PASSPHRASE is unset.
By default, Stonrick runs a backup at 02:00 each day.
